main_text.p: præf. pass βλέπομαι videor, 2.Cor.4.18. τὰ βλεπόμενα πρόσκαιρα, quæ videntur sunt temporaria.
Βοανηργὲς verba hæc sunt Syriaca, Marc.3.17. Græcè υἱοὶ βροντῆς, filii tonitrui. Sic Johannes & Jacobus fuerunt dicti.
Βοάω ὢ clamo, imperf. ἐβόων ὢν. Fut. βοήσω. P. βεβόηκα. a.1. ἐβόησα. a.1. imperat. βόησον ὑπὸ vociferare, Gal.4.27.
Βοήθεια ας ἡ adjumentum, auxilium, Heb.4.16.

Βοηθέω ὢ auxilior, succurro. q.d. ἐπὶ τὸν βοῶν θέω, ad clamorem curro. F. ηὴσω. P. βεβοήθηκα. a.1. ἐβοήθησα. a.1. imper. βοήθησον ὑπὸ, Matth.15.v.25. Κύριε βοήθει μοι, Domine succurre mihi. βοήθει contracte pro βοήθες. præf. imper. 2.sing. act.
Βοηθὸς ὁ auxiliator, Heb.13.6. Κύριός μοι βοηθός.
Βολὴ ῆς ἡ jactus à præt. med. βέβολα jeci verbi βάλλω, Luc.22.41.
Βολὶς ἴδος ἡ jaculum. item funis alligato plumbo, quo nautæ profunditatem aquarum explorant, Heb.12.20.
Βολίζω bolidem demitto. Fut. ἰσω. P. βεβόλικα. aor.1. ἐβόλισα. part. aor.1. βολίσας αὐτὸν ὁ. Act.27.28.

page.notes: Left margin strip contains fragmentary notes from the facing page (for example "Apoc.16.4", "Matth.", "Act.6.13", "Col.3.8") that are too cut off to transcribe reliably. Several Greek words are uncertain in their accents and are marked only implicitly; the Greek forms are transcribed as best read from the scan. The first entry continues from the previous page.
